senses.gloss:
(उ) ध्वंसु r. 1st cl. (ध्वंसते)
1 To fall down.
2 To reduce to powder.
3 To go.

m. (-सः)
Loss, destruction.
f. (-सी)
A mote in a sun-beam.
E.
ध्वंस to fall, affix अच्.

n. (-नं)
1 Perishing, dying.
2 Loss, destruction.
3 Going.
4 Falling.
E.
ध्वंस to fall down, affix ल्युट्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Lost, destroyed.
2 Vexed, incensed.
E.
ध्वंस to fall down, क्त aff.

mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि)
1 Destructive, destroying.
2 Suffering loss, perishing.
m. (-सी)
A Pilu tree, said to grow in mountainous districts.
E.
ध्वंस to fall, and इनि aff.

r. 1st cl. (ध्वजति) also (इ) ध्वजि r. 1st cl. (ध्वंजति)
To go, to move.

mn. (-जः-जं)
1 A flag or banner.
2 A mark, a sign or symbol.
3 The penis.
4 The upper part of a skull carried on a stick, as a penance for the murder of a Brahman.
5 A house situated to the east of any object.
6 A flag-staff.
7 (In Prosody,) An Iambic.
m. (-जः)
1 A distiller.
2 Pride.
3 Hypocrisy, fraud.
E.
ध्वज to go, affix अच्.

m. (-मः)
The palm tree.
E.
ध्वज a banner, द्रुम a tree.

m. (-णः)
Air or wind.
E.
ध्वज a flag, and प्रहरण who seizes.

m. (-ङ्गः)
1 Impotence.
2 Fracture or fall of a banner.
E.
ध्वज, and भङ्ग breaking.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Having a mark or sign.
m. (-वान्)
1 An ensign, a standard-bearer.
2 A distiller, a vender of spirituous liquors.
3 A Brahman who having slain another, carries the skull of the murdered man with him to places of pilgrimage by way of penance.
E.
ध्वज as above, मतुप् aff.

mfn. (-जी-जिनी-जि)
Bearing or displaying ensigns.
E.
ध्वज, and राज to shine, णिनि aff.

m. (-कः)
A flag.
E.
ध्वज, and अंशुक a cloth.

mfn. (-जी-जिनी-जि)
Having a flag or sign, &c.
m. (-जी)
1 A Brahman.
2 A mountain.
3 A car or carriage.
4 A snake.
5 A horse.
6 A peacock.
7 A distiller or vender of spirituous liquors.
8 A standard-bearer.
9 An armiger, one having an emblem or sign.
f. (-नी)
An army.
E.
ध्वज symbol, इनि aff.

n. (-णं)
1 Raising a standard.
2 Taking an emblem, &c.
3 Making any thing a plea, or setting up as a claim or right.
E.
ध्वज, and करण making, च्चि augment.

n. (-नं)
The twelfth day of the light half of Bhādra, a festival in honour of INDRA.
E.
ध्वज a flag, and उत्थान elevating.

r. 1st cl. (ध्वणति)
To sound.

r. 1st cl. (ध्वनति) r. 10th cl. (ध्वनयति ध्वानयति)
To sound.

m. (-नः)
Sound.
E.
ध्वन to sound, अच् affix: see ध्वान.

n. (-नं)
Sound in general.
E.
ध्वन to sound, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-नन्-नन्ती-नत्)
Sounding, making a noise.
E.
ध्वन to sound, शतृ aff.

m. (-दी)
The humble bee.
E.
ध्वन sound, and मोदिन् who delights.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Sounding, resounding, echoing with.
E.
ध्वन to sound, शतृ aff.

m. (-निः)
1 Sound.
2 Figurative or poetical style.
3 The sound of a drum.
E.
ध्वन to sound, इ aff.

m. (-हः)
1 The ear.
2 Hearing.
E.
ध्वनि sound, ग्रह the recipient.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Sounded, making a noise, as a drum, &c.
2 Poetical, figurative, rhetorically expressed.
E.
ध्वन to sound, affix क्त.

f. (-ला)
1 The Vīṇā or lute.
2 A pipe, a fife.
3 A sort of trumpet.
E.
ध्वनि sound, and नाला a hollow tube.

m. (-रः)
Change of voice, through fear, grief, &c.
E.
ध्वनि sound, विकार change.

mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं)
1 Fallen.
2 Destroyed, perished, lost.
E.
ध्वंस to fall, affix क्त.

(इ) ध्वाक्षि r. 1st cl. (ध्वांक्षति)
1 To utter a cry peculiar to birds, as to croke, caw, &c.
2 To desire.

m. (-ङ्क्षः)
1 Any aquatick bird, as a crane, a gull, &c. feeding upon fish.
2 A crow.
3 One of the Nāgas.
4 A beggar.
f. (-ङ्क्षी)
1 A drug: see काकोली.
2 A female imp or fiend.
E.
ध्वाङ्क्ष to cry, affix अच्; it and its derivatives may also be read ध्माक्ष, &c.

m. (-ष्टः)
The Kokila or Indian cuckoo.
E.
ध्वाङ्क्ष a crow, and पुष्ट fostered.

mfn. (-वी-विणी-वि)
Having a voice like a crow.
E.
ध्वाङ्क्ष a crow, and रव sound, affix णिनि.

m. (-तिः)
An owl.
E.
ध्वाङ्क्ष a crow, and अराति an enemy.

f. (-ली)
A medicinal plant: see काकोली.

n. (-न्तं)
Darkness.
E.
ध्वन to sound, क्त affix, deriv. irr.

m. (-त्तः)
The firefly.
E.
ध्वान्त darkness, and वित्त wealth.

m. (-बः)
1 A sort of Cassia, (C. fistula.)
2 The sun or any luminous body.
E.
ध्वान्त darkness, and शात्रव averse to.

m. (-तिः)
The sun or any luminous body.
E.
ध्वान्त darkness, and अरानि an enemy.

m. (-षः)
The firefly.
E.
ध्वान्त darkness, and उन्मेष twinkling.
